hotels.title: Stylish Heathrow Airport Hyatt Stay with Easy Access to Central London
hotels.description: Moments from Heathrow Airport, this contemporary west London stay places Terminal 2 within easy reach and central London within reach via the Elizabeth line from nearby Hayes & Harlington. Sleek rooms feature Hyatt Grand Beds, blackout curtains and soundproofing designed for restful stopovers. In the hotel, Gallery Café serves globally inspired plates and all-day dining, while the Coffee to Cocktails Bar pours barista-made coffee and evening drinks. Beyond the runway, stroll Windsor’s cobbled streets to Windsor Castle or dine on refined British fare at The Loch & The Tyne in nearby Old Windsor
